comment.body:
Thanks for reporting both tests: reinstalling did not restore New+, while the symptom changed after you added Everyone Full Control to the two PowerToys folders. That broad permission is not a recommended fix, and we do not want you to retain or add broad permissions for troubleshooting.

Could you confirm:

1. Whether those temporary Everyone Full Control entries are still present. If you already restored the prior/default permissions, please confirm that.
2. Whether New+ remains visible after restarting PowerToys with the prior/default permissions.

If the entries are still present or you are unsure how to restore the prior state, please say so and do not make further permission changes; maintainers can advise on the next safe step.
